6450.title: Connect gate failures and thread-loading delays
6450.rootCauseOneLine: Uncaught gate exceptions yield a generic 502; controlled failures reproduce the response, but the production trigger and latency remain unverified.
6450.proposedFix: Correlate a failing request with stored gate logs and tunnel metrics, then reproduce its specific dependency failure in staging before changing production code.
6450.caveats: Fault-injected response-path reproduction only, not spontaneous failures under normal browsing. Two clean checkouts each passed 298 Connect tests and 30 focused tests. The full-repository build hit unrelated missing SDK artifacts. Runner and test evidence are embedded in the HTML; raw artifacts remain local.
